sentences.text: When a nerve is damaged, the muscle it supplies grows weak.
The ending was so tense it shredded every nerve I had.
Toxins such as sarin attack the nerves within minutes.
It takes a lot of nerve to ask for a raise.
In the spinal cord, each sensory nerve carries signals from the skin.
Pain, burning and tingling along the nerve are typical of shingles.
After the burn, the raw skin and its nerves throbbed with pain.
Touch and temperature reach the brain through the trigeminal nerve.
When he tried to hold her hand, she pulled her hand away.
The child snatched his hand back from the dog's mouth.
The snail retracted its feelers the moment I touched them.
She jerked her foot back when the cold water touched her toes.
She pulled her hand out of her pocket and waved.
He pulled the drawer back and found the letter.
The general pulled back his troops before dawn.
He raised his hand to ask a question.
The bullet went straight into his leg.
The dog bit the postman on the hand.
The doctor examined his leg and found nothing wrong.
She raised her hand and waved at the bus.
